top_signals.title: From Hormuz to the Caucasus: The New Geography of Energy Security
top_signals.summary:
Every crisis in the Middle East returns the world’s attention to the same stretch of water. When tankers are seized, or missiles fly near the Persian Gulf, oil prices move, insurers reprice risk, shipping reroutes, and the United States repositions naval and airpower to keep the Strait of Hormuz open. The reflex is sound, because the strait carries volumes nothing else can. top_signals.title: Warsh Needs to Respond to Rising Inflation, George Says
top_signals.summary: Former Kansas City Fed President Esther George said that Kevin Warsh will be under pressure to signal how the Fed intends to respond to inflation that has stopped cooling and “is not turning in the direction that the committee had hoped." She speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance" at the Jackson Hole Economic Policy Symposium. (Source: Bloomberg)
